🚀 NEW FEATURES:
• Enhanced Device Management - View logged-in devices and remote logout
• Feedback System - Share suggestions to improve the app
• Interactive Tutorial - Step-by-step guided tours
• Secure AI Chatbot - Encrypted farming advice assistant
• Live Weather Integration - Real-time location-based weather data
• Google Sign-in - Quick and secure authentication

✨ IMPROVEMENTS:
• Report generation and download
• Improved egg data handling (latest entry overwrites previous same-day data)
• Enhanced functionality and bug fixes
